intro: Where DomainDetective, its browser tools and DnsClientX are heading. This is a direction, not a delivery promise: items move as we learn, and the engineering detail lives in each repository.

tracks.name: DomainDetective
tracks.summary: The analysis engine, PowerShell module, CLI and reports.

now.title: Public packages
now.detail: Publish DomainDetective to NuGet and the PowerShell Gallery, and the CLI as a .NET tool, so the install commands on this site work everywhere.

now.title: DnsClientX upgrade
now.detail: Move to the next public DnsClientX release with its DNSSEC and transport fixes, validated against the package rather than local source.

now.title: One report, every format
now.detail: Word, Markdown, HTML and Excel reports share one set of section facts, statuses and references, checked by a parity fixture.

next.title: Enforcement readiness
next.detail: Evidence-based guidance on when DMARC, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT are ready to move to enforcement.

next.title: Per-MX transport evidence
next.detail: STARTTLS coverage and certificate paths for every mail exchanger in reports.

next.title: Registration that degrades well
next.detail: RDAP first, with a bounded WHOIS fallback and clear status meanings.

next.title: Wider qualification
next.detail: DANE-TA against live services, RFC 9990/9991 DMARC reports with real producer samples, and internationalised DKIM/ARC selectors.

exploring.title: Scheduled audits
exploring.detail: Local run history, alert thresholds and a bounded export format for recurring checks.

exploring.title: Portfolio drift
exploring.detail: Snapshots across many domains to show what changed and when.

exploring.title: Batch presets
exploring.detail: Shared CLI and PowerShell batch inputs and CSV output, if they improve on piping.

tracks.name: Browser tools and website
tracks.summary: domaindetective.dev, the browser tools and the services around them.

now.title: Faster, clearer tools
now.detail: Static tool pages, an instant DNS first look, a smaller engine download and verdict-first results.

now.title: Edge caching for the engine
now.detail: Serve the fingerprinted WebAssembly files from Cloudflare's cache with long-lived headers and Brotli.

now.title: Checklist results everywhere
now.detail: Bring the problems-first checklist to certificates, HTTP headers, DANE, BIMI and CAA.

next.title: Deeper checks online
next.detail: An optional hosted service for the checks a browser cannot run, such as HTTP, TLS handshakes and RDAP, without storing results.

next.title: Certificate Transparency monitoring
next.detail: Open the private CT preview: new certificates for your domains as they are logged, including lookalikes.

next.title: Share and export
next.detail: Shareable links and downloadable reports straight from a browser run.

exploring.title: Compare domains
exploring.detail: Side-by-side posture for a domain and its subsidiaries, brands or vendors.

exploring.title: Guided fixes
exploring.detail: Copy-ready DNS records for the fix-first items, tailored to the provider that hosts the zone.

tracks.name: DnsClientX
tracks.summary: The DNS client for .NET and PowerShell underneath everything here.

now.title: Next public release
now.detail: Ship the merged work: ODoH and DNSCrypt packages, the EdDSA DNSSEC provider, DDR, the CLI and seven new cmdlets.

now.title: A home of its own
now.detail: A dedicated DnsClientX page, transport and DNSSEC guides and a live resolver on this site.

now.title: Native CLI archives
now.detail: Exercise CLI builds on their native x64 and ARM64 platforms.

next.title: Independent qualification
next.detail: Test against independently operated authoritative servers alongside the reproducible BIND lab.

next.title: Split DNS everywhere
next.detail: Extend search-domain and split-DNS evidence beyond Windows NRPT and Linux to macOS scoped resolvers and common VPNs.

next.title: Privacy stamps
next.detail: DNS stamp workflows for ODoH and DNSCrypt, plus mobile native assets.

exploring.title: DNS policy evaluator
exploring.detail: One deterministic DNS-only evaluator for blocking, static answers and resolver selection.

exploring.title: Published performance numbers
exploring.detail: Repeatable benchmarks that separate allocations, throughput and network latency.

exploring.title: Post-quantum DNSCrypt
exploring.detail: Under its own compatibility and dependency contract.
